title: Not worth the effort!
text:
Not worth the effort!. I think this is a case where the old fashioned way is better. Pull the pot out, fille it with water and time your eggs on the stove. There are too many devices for us these days. We do not need more that are not necessary. I would not try cooking a scrambled egg. I have boiled eggs and not with great consistency.

The device is lightweight.....too lightweight. So, this is more trouble than it is worth.
